blockers.title: Tracked-vs-deployed equivalence not demonstrated
blockers.detail: Three files were newly tracked but only two artifact hashes were reported; the core claim that the repository reflects the deployed control plane was unverified.

blockers.title: ArtifactStore resolution widening and exposed read path
blockers.detail: Root containment, symlink/realpath checks, traversal rejection and manifest-declared allowlisting were not evidenced for group-accessible status sockets.

blockers.title: Signal receive path lacks end-to-end evidence and has a silent-empty risk
blockers.detail: Daemon errors, timeouts and startup races were not proven distinguishable from an empty poll; live inbound and 2FA remained untested.

blockers.title: No release authority or executor was asserted by absence
blockers.detail: No positive fail-closed tests proved that order, release and execute paths are rejected on both sockets and by the dispatcher.

major_findings: Socket authorization boundary was unproven beyond protocol behavior; no negative command tests or topdelivery group audit were cited.
Hermes runtime isolation lacked restart/reboot and stale-socket evidence.
Omitting the account selector is coupled to the single-account daemon state and lacked a second-account guard.
TRUSTED_UNVERIFIED identity status required fail-closed fingerprint handling and protected pin evidence.
Bounded daemon errors needed an explicit bound and redaction guarantee.
Queue/lease/retry without an executor risked expiry retry storms, duplicate delivery and ambiguous acknowledgement.
Dependency/interpreter pinning, signed provenance and a rollback restore rehearsal were not evidenced.
38 focused tests lacked explicit traversal, negative authorization, concurrency, restart/reboot, lease and deployed-import coverage.
A self-reported acceptance hash lacked an external or append-only witness.
minor_findings: Generic controller module names risk import-order shadowing.
Compileall and diff-check do not prove service-context imports.
Operator residuals lacked timeout and abort criteria.
Hash labels were ambiguous across the three tracked controller files.
Run-manifest-relative behavior for prior runs was not stated.
required_tests: Per-file tracked/deployed SHA-256 equality for all three controller files and the adapter.
ArtifactStore tests for absolute paths, traversal, encoded/unicode traversal, symlink escapes, hardlinks, root-prefix collisions, missing entries and TOCTOU.
Allowlist test proving only manifest-declared artifacts are readable.
Negative socket tests for mutating, unknown, malformed and oversized requests on both sockets.
Fail-closed rejection tests for order, release and execute-shaped commands.
Signal tests for daemon down, startup, timeout, malformed JSON, multi-account state and redacted bounded errors.
Fingerprint mismatch and missing-pin fail-closed tests.
Redaction tests for messages, phone numbers and 2FA codes.
Lease expiry, duplicate retry, idempotency and heartbeat-loss tests.
Rollback restore rehearsal using the pre-change archive.
required_operator_actions: Publish a path-to-SHA mapping for every deployed file.
Audit topdelivery group membership and socket mode.
Verify fail-closed fingerprint pin storage and mismatch behavior.
Perform live Signal inbound and 2FA tests.
Externally witness or sign the acceptance hash.
Reboot comms-01 and re-capture service/socket evidence.
Document the single-account precondition and guard.
